text:
You may be able to make this much more affordable. Start by filing the **FAFSA** at **studentaid.gov**—it unlocks most aid.

You may qualify for:
- **Federal Pell Grant** — free money, no repayment
- **Florida Bright Futures** — if you meet Florida GPA/test/residency rules
- **FSAG** — Florida grant aid for eligible students
- **Federal Work-Study** — part-time campus job aid
- **MDC scholarships** — free money from the college

I don’t have the MDC price-per-credit data, so I can’t give an exact dollar estimate. But grants and scholarships can cut your cost a lot, and loans, if you use them, do need to be repaid.

**Next step:** file the FAFSA now, then contact **MDC Financial Aid** for help.
